description: Header file defining classes and structures for managing QUIC stream priorities, including HTTP and WebTransport priorities, with serialization and parsing functions.

classes.name: HttpStreamPriority
classes.description: Represents HTTP priorities as defined by RFC 9218, including urgency and incremental flags.

classes.name: WebTransportStreamPriority
classes.description: Represents WebTransport stream priorities with stream type and send order.

classes.name: QuicStreamPriority
classes.description: A wrapper class that can hold either HttpStreamPriority or WebTransportStreamPriority for scheduling QUIC streams.

methods.name: SerializePriorityFieldValue
methods.description: Serializes HttpStreamPriority into a string for PRIORITY_UPDATE frames.

methods.name: ParsePriorityFieldValue
methods.description: Parses a string from PRIORITY_UPDATE frames into an HttpStreamPriority object.
